name: Sheets
statusNote: Bottom sheet: spring-driven motion, deterministic partial-expand, drag boundary damping near dismiss. Side sheet: geometry unchanged from M3, but no Compose implementation exists in this source tree (gap; see notes).
summary: Surfaces anchored to a screen edge that hold supplementary content: bottom sheets rise from the bottom edge, side sheets slide in from left/right. Each has a standard (persistent, no scrim) and modal (blocking, scrimmed) form.

inputs.name: edge
inputs.description: Which screen edge the sheet is anchored to.

inputs.name: modal
inputs.description: Modal blocks interaction and shows a scrim; standard coexists with screen content and shows none.

inputs.name: onDismissRequest
inputs.description: Called when the sheet should be dismissed (scrim tap, drag past threshold, Escape, or back gesture).

inputs.name: sheetState
inputs.description: Bottom sheet: the Hidden/PartiallyExpanded/Expanded anchor state, hoistable so a caller can drive it directly.

inputs.name: maxWidth
inputs.description: Bottom sheet: the sheet's maximum width in dp, regardless of viewport.

inputs.name: dragHandle
inputs.description: Optional drag handle content; omit to render no handle.

inputs.name: shape
inputs.description: Override for the sheet container's corner shape.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: Bottom sheet: the sheet surface. Side sheet: the sheet surface, standard or modal.

anatomy.name: Drag handle
anatomy.description: Bottom sheet only, optional: a static pill styled from comp.sheet-bottom.docked-drag-handle-*, distinct from the generic comp.drag-handle component.

anatomy.name: Close affordance
anatomy.description: Side sheet: an icon button; modal additionally adds a header, close icon button, optional leading back icon button, and optional action row.

variants.description: Coexists with screen content, no scrim.
Persistent panel beside content. No dedicated side-sheet tokens exist; substituted from comp.navigation-drawer.*, the nearest analogous edge-anchored panel.
Blocks interaction, scrim. Same navigation-drawer substitution as side-standard.

layout.text: Max width is 640dp regardless of viewport.

Anchors: Hidden at full container height; Expanded at fullHeight - sheetHeight; PartiallyExpanded is available whenever not skipped and sits at fullHeight - min(fullHeight/2, sheetHeight) — a sheet shorter than half the screen shows its full height with no artificial gap, i.e. PartiallyExpanded converges with Expanded rather than being a fixed 50% anchor. Best modeled as "may equal Expanded", not a guaranteed halfway stop — don't hard-code a 50% height.
Drag settle uses a positional threshold of 56dp and a velocity threshold of 125dp/s to decide which anchor a drag/fling resolves to.

Within 125dp of the Hidden anchor, fling velocity is damped by a quadratic factor of the remaining distance, clamped to not drop below the velocity threshold — this stops the expressive spring from overshooting the screen edge during a fast dismiss swipe.
The default drag handle shape comes from the theme's extra-large corner shape, not from a comp.sheet-bottom shape token; it sits 22dp from the sheet's top edge.

Predictive back scales the sheet down from a bottom-center-ish transform origin, capped at 48dp horizontal / 24dp vertical scale distance; inner content is scaled inversely on Y to keep its own aspect ratio.
docked-standard-container-elevation and docked-modal-container-elevation are both level1, but only the modal one is wired as the default tonal elevation.

No spec-mandated width exists (MDC's own example uses 256dp, not a default); the navigation-drawer's container-width (360) and container-shape (rounded only on the edge away from the screen border) are the nearest existing tokens, and their standard/modal color+elevation split matches MDC's side-sheet color table exactly. Treat this as a considered default, not a verified Expressive value, until a real comp.side-sheet.* group ships upstream.

states.text: Modal variants show a scrim; alpha fades 0 to 1 with a default-effects spring. Clicking it dismisses if configured to.

states.label: enter
states.text: Bottom sheet enter uses a default-spatial spring; drag/fling settle also uses the default-spatial spring.

states.label: dismiss
states.text: Bottom sheet dismiss/hide uses a fast-effects spring.

states.label: click-cycle
states.text: Clicking the drag handle cycles state: Expanded dismisses, PartiallyExpanded expands, otherwise (Hidden) shows.

behaviour.text: Two unrelated "drag handle" specs share this file: comp.drag-handle.* belongs to the generic VerticalDragHandle — a vertically-oriented handle for dragging something horizontally (e.g. a resizable pane divider), with distinct default/pressed/dragged colors, shapes and sizes. The bottom sheet's own handle is styled from comp.sheet-bottom.docked-drag-handle-* instead, and has no pressed/dragged visual state at all — it is a static pill. Don't reuse one spec for the other.
Side sheet states per MDC: Expanded, Hidden, Dragging, Settling; draggable by default.

keyboard: Tab moves focus through the sheet's content in document order.
semantics: Bottom sheet exposes a pane title and, when gestures are enabled, dismiss/expand/collapse semantic actions on the drag handle so assistive tech can drive state without a drag gesture.
MDC's drag-handle view enforces a 48dp minimum touch target; Compose's default drag handle does not add this itself — reserve at least 48dp of tappable height around the visual handle.
Side sheet close/back affordances are ordinary icon buttons — the standard minimum touch target applies.

notes.text: There is no Compose side-sheet composable in this source tree at all (confirmed by search); the side-sheet layout above is built from MDC-Android docs plus the navigation-drawer token substitution. Treat any side-sheet width/elevation/shape as a considered default, not a verified Expressive value, until a real comp.side-sheet.* group ships upstream.
Bottom sheet's PartiallyExpanded is best modeled as "may equal Expanded" rather than a guaranteed halfway stop — don't hard-code a 50% height.
